instruction: Stand the red pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
c = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)][0]
grasp_res = grasp(c)

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# The pen is held horizontally across the finger axis (along side vector).
# To place it upright into the holder, orient the gripper so the pen aligns vertically (pointing down).
# Approach pointing horizontally, fingers vertical -> side is vertical along Z.
# Let's orient the gripper with approach horizontal (e.g. [1, 0, 0]) and finger_axis horizontal or approach along X, finger along Y -> side is [0, 0, 1] (or [0, 0, -1]).
# First move well above the holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.20)

# Move above holder and turn gripper to align pen vertically into holder
# If side = approach x finger_axis is along [0, 0, -1] or [0, 0, 1], pen will be vertical.
# approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] gives side = [0, 0, 1].
target_z = hz + rim_h + 0.12
move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="joint")

# Lower down into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.08)

open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")
